name: F_cfg20_lr150_hxu02

validation.method: Same-batch F sweep (12 configs run simultaneously on identical GPU contention)

comment: Winner from a 167-config corpus across 4 sweep stages (E:45 + P:78 + F:12 + 32 from larger_box). The F batch eliminated co-tenancy noise by running same-batch with 4 anchor reruns. F_cfg20_lr150_hxu02 has the lowest LPIPS (0.1200) and lowest |dHF| (0.010) in the entire corpus while staying above the 17 dB PSNR floor. Wing-pattern detail in the recon box is genuinely present and not fake grain (verified visually). The CFG=2.0 + lambda_reg=150 combination strengthens both the prior push and the data fidelity, while h_x=0.2 uniform applies the prior step across all 4 stages instead of only stage-3 amplification.
